scope: Finite certificates only; no complete PDE formalization

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.bStarZero_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem bStarZero_identity (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    bStarZero α = α / (2 * (2 - α))

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.leading_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem leading_identity (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    leading α = 1 + α / (2 * (2 - α))

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.leading_gt_one
theorems.statement:
theorem leading_gt_one (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    1 < leading α

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.leading_three_quarters
theorems.statement: theorem leading_three_quarters : leading (3 / 4 : ℝ) = 13 / 10

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.fourthRootTwo_fourth
theorems.statement: theorem fourthRootTwo_fourth : ((2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ (4 : ℕ) = 2

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.fourthRootTwo_lt_thirteen_tenths
theorems.statement: theorem fourthRootTwo_lt_thirteen_tenths : (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 13 / 10

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.oldestSecond_three_quarters
theorems.statement:
theorem oldestSecond_three_quarters :
    oldestSecond (3 / 4 : ℝ) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) - 13 / 10

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.oldestSecond_three_quarters_neg
theorems.statement: theorem oldestSecond_three_quarters_neg : oldestSecond (3 / 4 : ℝ) < 0

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.history_abs_budget
theorems.statement:
theorem history_abs_budget (d₀ d₁ : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < d₀) (h₁ : d₁ < 0) :
    |d₀ - d₁| + |d₁| = d₀ - 2 * d₁ ∧ d₀ < |d₀ - d₁| + |d₁|

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.signedHistory_triangle
theorems.statement:
theorem signedHistory_triangle {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c u : ι → ℝ) :
    ‖∑ j ∈ s, c j * u j‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, |c j| * |u j|

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.signed_sum_bound_false
theorems.statement:
theorem signed_sum_bound_false :
    ¬ ∀ (c₀ c₁ u₀ u₁ : ℝ), |u₀| ≤ 1 → |u₁| ≤ 1 →
      |c₀ * u₀ + c₁ * u₁| ≤ |c₀ + c₁|

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.l12_assigned_state_counterexample
LegendreAudit.telescoping_history
theorems.statement:
theorem telescoping_history (d : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range k, (d r - d (r + 1))) + d k = d 0

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.telescoping_not_one
theorems.statement:
theorem telescoping_not_one (α : ℝ) (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1)
    (d : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hd : d 0 = leading α) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range k, (d r - d (r + 1))) + d k ≠ 1

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.normalized_history
theorems.statement:
theorem normalized_history (d : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hd : d 0 ≠ 0) :
    ((∑ r ∈ Finset.range k, (d r - d (r + 1))) + d k) / d 0 = 1

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.no_uniform_weighted_energy_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem no_uniform_weighted_energy_bound :
    ¬ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (w : ℝ), 0 < w → w ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (x y : ℝ), x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ≤ C * (x ^ 2 + w * y ^ 2)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.volterra_half_near_panel_positive
theorems.statement:
theorem volterra_half_near_panel_positive :
    0 < (1 + 1 / Real.sqrt 2) / 2 - 2 * (Real.sqrt 2 - 1)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.mass_polynomial
theorems.statement:
theorem mass_polynomial (c x : ℝ) :
    massIntegrand c x = x - 2 * x ^ 3 + x ^ 5 + c * x ^ 2 - 2 * c * x ^ 4 + c * x ^ 6

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.gll3_mass
theorems.statement: theorem gll3_mass (c : ℝ) : gll3 (massIntegrand c) = 16 * c / 75

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.mass_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement:
theorem mass_hasDerivAt (c x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (massPrimitive c) (massIntegrand c x) x

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.mass_integral
theorems.statement:
theorem mass_integral (c : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, massIntegrand c x) = 16 * c / 105

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.positive_mass_coefficient
theorems.statement:
theorem positive_mass_coefficient (c x : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hx0 : -1 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) : 0 < 1 + c * x

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.gll3_variable_coefficient_counterexample
theorems.statement:
theorem gll3_variable_coefficient_counterexample (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1) :
    |gll3 (massIntegrand c) - (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, massIntegrand c x)| = 32 * c / 525 ∧
      gll3 (massIntegrand c) ≠ (∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, massIntegrand c x)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.symbol_numerator
theorems.statement:
theorem symbol_numerator (x y rho q : ℝ) (h : y^2 = 1 - x^2) :
    ((1-x) + q*((1-x)^2-y^2))*(1-rho*x) +
      (y+2*q*(1-x)*y)*(rho*y) =
      (1-x)*(1+rho+2*q*(rho-x))

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.symbol_bracket
theorems.statement:
theorem symbol_bracket (rho q x : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ rho) (hr' : rho ≤ 1)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq' : q ≤ 1/2) (hx : x ≤ 1) :
    2*rho ≤ 1+rho+2*q*(rho-x)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.smoothing_denominator
theorems.statement: theorem smoothing_denominator : (0 : ℚ) < 1-17*(512/1000000)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.smoothing_amplitude
theorems.statement: theorem smoothing_amplitude : (17 : ℚ)/(1-17*(512/1000000)) < 18

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.weighted_contraction
theorems.statement: theorem weighted_contraction : ((3 : ℚ)+800/64)/64 < 1/4

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.homogeneous_contraction
theorems.statement: theorem homogeneous_contraction : (1 : ℚ)/128*(21/4)*(3+1/16) < 1/4

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.fractional_parameter_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem fractional_parameter_bound :
    (720000 : ℚ)*2^512*(1/2^600) < 1/2^68

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.fractional_parameter_admissibility
theorems.statement:
theorem fractional_parameter_admissibility :
    (0 : ℚ) < 1/2^600 ∧ (1 : ℚ)/2^600 ≤ 1-1/2^600 ∧ (1 : ℚ)-1/2^600 < 1

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.finite_summation_by_parts
theorems.statement:
theorem finite_summation_by_parts (w u : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), w j * (u (j + 1) - u j)) =
      w N * u (N + 1) - w 0 * u 0 +
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (w j - w (j + 1)) * u (j + 1)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.quadratic_history_collection
theorems.statement:
theorem quadratic_history_collection (c v : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range N,
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c (n - j) * (v (j + 1) - v j)) =
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, c (N - 1 - j) * v (j + 1)) -
        (∑ r ∈ Finset.range N, c r) * v 0

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.reversed_difference_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem reversed_difference_sum (b : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (b (N - j) - b (N - 1 - j))) = b N - b 0

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.pre_derivative
theorems.statement:
theorem pre_derivative (γ t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (prePosition γ) (preVelocity γ t) t

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.critical_position
theorems.statement:
theorem critical_position (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    prePosition γ (1 / γ) = Real.exp (-1) / γ

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.critical_velocity
theorems.statement:
theorem critical_velocity (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    preVelocity γ (1 / γ) = 0

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.post_derivative
theorems.statement:
theorem post_derivative (γ ω y₀ s : ℝ) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (postPosition γ ω y₀) (postVelocity γ ω y₀ s) s

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.quarter_velocity
theorems.statement:
theorem quarter_velocity (γ ω y₀ : ℝ) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    postVelocity γ ω y₀ (Real.pi / (2 * ω)) =
      -y₀ * (ω + γ ^ 2 / ω) * Real.exp (-γ * (Real.pi / (2 * ω)))

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.st05_endpoint_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem st05_endpoint_identity (γ : ℝ) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    postVelocity γ (16 * γ) (Real.exp (-1) / γ) (Real.pi / (2 * (16 * γ))) =
      -(16 + 1 / 16 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-1 - Real.pi / 32)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD01.oscillator_energy_algebra
theorems.statement:
theorem oscillator_energy_algebra (k x y : ℝ) :
    2 * k * x * y + 2 * y * (-k * x - 2 * y) = -4 * y ^ 2

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.row_tail_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem row_tail_identity (s : Finset ℕ) (w dv : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, w k * ∑ m ∈ s with m ≤ k, dv m) =
      ∑ m ∈ s, dv m * ∑ k ∈ s with m ≤ k, w k

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.ordered_vector_domination
theorems.statement:
theorem ordered_vector_domination (s : Finset ℕ) (w d dv : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ m ∈ s, 0 ≤ dv m)
    (ht : ∀ m ∈ s, (∑ k ∈ s with m ≤ k, w k) ≤ ∑ k ∈ s with m ≤ k, d k) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, w k * ∑ m ∈ s with m ≤ k, dv m) ≤
      ∑ k ∈ s, d k * ∑ m ∈ s with m ≤ k, dv m

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.increment_reconstruction
theorems.statement:
theorem increment_reconstruction (v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (v (j+1)-v j)) = v n-v 0

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.finite_word_domination
theorems.statement:
theorem finite_word_domination {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (B D : ι → (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ))
    (cone : (Fin n → ℝ) → Prop)
    (hB : ∀ i, Monotone (B i))
    (hD : ∀ i v, cone v → cone (D i v))
    (hBD : ∀ i v, cone v → B i v ≤ D i v)
    (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : cone v) (word : List ι) :
    word.foldr (fun i x => B i x) v ≤ word.foldr (fun i x => D i x) v

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.cumulative_weights
theorems.statement:
theorem cumulative_weights (f : ℕ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (C : ℝ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, C*(f (m+j+1)-f (m+j))) = C*(f (m+n)-f m)

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.shifted_energy_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem shifted_energy_identity (h : ℕ → ℝ) (v : ℕ → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (vn vs : ℝ) :
    2*(∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, h j*(vn-v j))*vs -
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, h j*(vn^2-(v j)^2)) =
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, h j*(vs-v j)^2) -
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, h j)*(vn-vs)^2

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.linear_absolute_basis
theorems.statement:
theorem linear_absolute_basis (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1) :
    |1-x|+|x| = 1

theorems.name: LegendreAudit.AUD02.forward_moment_identities
LegendreAudit.AUD02.backward_moment_identities
LegendreAudit.AUD02.complementary_composition
theorems.statement:
theorem complementary_composition (s : Finset ℕ) (P dv : ℕ → ℝ)
    (A : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (h : ∀ k ∈ s, (∑ j ∈ s, P j*A j k)=1) :
    (∑ j ∈ s, P j*(∑ k ∈ s, A j k*dv k)) = ∑ k ∈ s, dv k
